title: Installation and Subscription Settings
content:
Managed services terms for SSL/TLS Certificates: when installation may be ordered, how a paid certificate sits beside the free AutoSSL certificate of a Harborline hosting plan, and when a subscription's settings may be changed.

## Terms in force

**T1 — Status for an installation.** An installation may be ordered only while the subscription status is active, as shown on the subscription record for that subscription reference number. A subscription still pending validation, or one that is expired, revoked or cancelled, has no installation ordered under it.

**T2 — Paid certificate and AutoSSL.** On a Harborline hosting plan a paid certificate installed for a name replaces the plan's free AutoSSL certificate for that name, and the two are never served for the same name at once.

**T3 — Settings.** Auto-renew may be switched on or off and the installation plan changed at any time while the subscription is pending validation or active.

| Subscription status | Order an installation | Switch auto-renew or change the installation plan |
|---|---|---|
| pending validation | no | yes |
| active | yes | yes |
| expired, revoked or cancelled | no | no |

## Term no longer in force

"On a Harborline hosting plan named as the certificate's installation plan, installation is free and automatic where the product installs free on Harborline hosting, and on any other server Harborline support installs it for the product's installation fee." This clause is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current managed installation rule.

## Figure these terms read

**Installation fee:** for each of the seven products, that product's published fee for installation by Harborline support on a server not hosted by Harborline.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical Harborline DV Wildcard subscription, pending validation, whose holder wants auto-renew switched off and the installation plan moved to another Harborline hosting plan: both settings may be changed now, but an installation may be ordered only once the subscription is active. When the paid certificate is later installed for its name on that Harborline hosting plan, it replaces the plan's free AutoSSL certificate for that name.

superseded_clauses: On a Harborline hosting plan named as the certificate's hosting_id installation is free and automatic where hosting_install_free is true, and on any other server Harborline support installs it for installation_fee.
